concerns.text: FR‑008 specifies that samples may be *optionally excluded* if a sensitivity analysis shows a Pearson correlation r ≥ 0.30 (p < 0.05) between a bulk‑surface discrepancy metric and PCE. This uses the outcome variable (PCE) to decide which data points are retained for the primary analysis, creating a circular/selection bias where the validation target influences the predictor set. Such post‑hoc exclusion undermines the independence of the validation target from the predictors and can inflate reported associations.
